advice.excellent: The vehicle is in excellent overall condition. No major reservation was noted during the inspection.
advice.good: The vehicle is in good overall condition. A few points should be monitored, none of them serious.
advice.fair: The vehicle is in fair condition. Repairs are needed in the short term and should be factored into the negotiation.
advice.poor: The vehicle is in poor condition. Major repairs are required before any purchase.

consistent.label: Consistent
consistent.title: Mileage consistent
consistent.fallback: The displayed mileage is consistent with the cross-checking information available during the inspection.

suspicious.label: Inconsistent — possible tampering
suspicious.title: Alert — suspicious mileage
suspicious.fallback: Discrepancies were found between the displayed mileage and the cross-checking information available. A thorough check is recommended before any purchase.

unverifiable.label: Unverifiable
unverifiable.title: Mileage unverifiable
unverifiable.fallback: The information needed to cross-check the displayed mileage (control units, service history, previous technical inspections) was not available during the inspection.

anomalies.none: No issue was found on the items checked during this inspection.

legal.notice: This report is a private technical inspection carried out at the client's request. It is not an official technical inspection report and in no way replaces the mandatory technical inspection issued by a centre approved by NARSA (National Road Safety Agency). It is neither a registration certificate nor a certificate of administrative compliance.

points.scope: The findings only cover the parts accessible without disassembly, at the date and time of the inspection.
points.disassembly: The inspection does not include engine disassembly, removal of components or dynamometer testing, unless expressly stated otherwise.
points.mileage: The mileage shown is the odometer reading. The expert assesses its consistency from the information available (on-board control units, service history, previous technical inspections) without being able to guarantee its authenticity.
points.estimates: Repair estimates are indicative, excluding taxes and genuine manufacturer parts.
points.liability: Neither the expert nor AutoSouk can be held liable for any defect appearing after the inspection date.
